# WARNING: Install these libraries before running this code.
We're using the *nhanesA* package instead of regular NHANES so that we can create an aggregate dataset that has more datapoints.

```{r Install Packages}
install.packages(c("dplyr", "nhanesA"), repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
```

## Raw Data Collection by Downloading from NHANES directly
We divide by three for the final line because each NHANES sample collects information from 300 million people.\\
Without dividing by three, it's equivalent to treating the dataset as sampling from 900 million people.\\

Note: we are specifically using the cycles from 2011 - 2016 because:\\
- Race encoding for Non-Hispanic Asian *(from 2011 onwards)*
- Alcohol consumption encoding was changed from 2017-2018 and onwards

```{r Create raw data table}

library(dplyr)
library(nhanesA)

cycles <- c("2011-2012" = "_G", "2013-2014" = "_H", "2015-2016" = "_I")

tables <- list(
  DEMO = c("RIDAGEYR", "RIAGENDR", "RIDRETH3", "DMDEDUC2", "DMDEDUC3",
           "SDMVPSU", "SDMVSTRA", "WTINT2YR", "WTMEC2YR"),
  BPX  = paste0("BPXSY", 1:4),
  BMX  = "BMXBMI",
  SLQ  = c("SLD010H", "SLD012"),
  PAQ  = c("PAQ650", "PAQ665", "PAQ710", "PAQ715"),
  ALQ  = c("ALQ101", "ALQ110", "ALQ120Q", "ALQ120U"),
  SMQ  = c("SMQ020", "SMQ040"),
  DUQ  = c("DUQ200", "DUQ211"),
  BPQ  = c("BPQ020", "BPQ040A", "BPQ050A"),
  DXX  = "DXDTOPF"
)

pieces <- list()
for (cyc in names(cycles)) {
  sfx    <- cycles[[cyc]]
  merged <- NULL
  for (tbl in names(tables)) {
    d <- nhanes(paste0(tbl, sfx), translated = FALSE)
    d <- select(d, SEQN, any_of(tables[[tbl]]))
    merged <- if (is.null(merged)) d else left_join(merged, d, by = "SEQN")
  }
  pieces[[cyc]] <- merged
}

# See write-up above to see why we divide by three
CDCdata <- mutate(bind_rows(pieces, .id = "Cycle"), WTMEC6YR = WTMEC2YR / 3)
```

### Optional: Export raw data to CSV

```{r Export CDCdata}
write.csv(CDCdata, "data/raw_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Re-encode arbitrary internal labels to intuitive names

```{r Label re-encoding}
decoded_data <- CDCdata %>%
  mutate(
    Age  = RIDAGEYR,                       # note: 80 means "80 or older"
    
    Sex  = factor(case_when(RIAGENDR == 1 ~ "Male",
                            RIAGENDR == 2 ~ "Female")),
    
    Race3 = factor(case_when(RIDRETH3 %in% 1:2 ~ "Hispanic",
                             RIDRETH3 == 3     ~ "White",
                             RIDRETH3 == 4     ~ "Black",
                             RIDRETH3 == 6     ~ "Asian",
                             RIDRETH3 == 7     ~ "Other"),
                   levels = c("White", "Hispanic", "Black", "Asian", "Other")),  # White = baseline
    
    CompletedCollege = factor(case_when(
                              DMDEDUC2 == 5                    ~ 1,   # college grad or above
                              DMDEDUC2 %in% 1:4                ~ 0,
                              DMDEDUC3 %in% c(0:15, 55, 66)    ~ 0,   # N/A: ages 18-19
                              )),
    
    BPSysAve = rowMeans(pick(starts_with("BPXSY")), na.rm = TRUE),
    BPSysAve = if_else(is.nan(BPSysAve), NA_real_, BPSysAve),
    
    BMI = BMXBMI,
    
    SleepHrsNight = coalesce(SLD010H, SLD012),
    SleepHrsNight = if_else(SleepHrsNight > 24, NA_real_, SleepHrsNight),
    
    PhysActive = factor(case_when(PAQ650 == 1 | PAQ665 == 1 ~ 1,   # Yes
                                  PAQ650 == 2 & PAQ665 == 2 ~ 0)), # No
    
    AlcoholYear = case_when(ALQ120Q == 0  ~ 0,            # Drank for zero days
                            ALQ120Q > 365 ~ NA_real_,     # Codes 777/999: refused/don't know
                            ALQ120U == 1  ~ ALQ120Q * 52, # Answered in terms of per week
                            ALQ120U == 2  ~ ALQ120Q * 12, # Answered in terms of per month
                            ALQ120U == 3  ~ ALQ120Q,      # Answered in terms of per year
                            is.na(ALQ120Q) & ALQ110 == 2 ~ 0), # Abstinent
    
    SmokeNow = factor(case_when(SMQ020 == 2     ~ 0, # N/A: never smoked 100 cigarettess
                                SMQ040 %in% 1:2 ~ 1,
                                SMQ040 == 3     ~ 0)),
  )

filtered_data <-  decoded_data |> select(SEQN, Cycle, SDMVPSU, SDMVSTRA, WTMEC6YR, # keep weight for re-sampling
                                  BPSysAve, Age, Sex, Race3, BMI, SleepHrsNight, PhysActive,
                                  AlcoholYear, SmokeNow, CompletedCollege)

# Filter for adults only
filtered_data <- filter(filtered_data, WTMEC6YR > 0, Age >= 18 & Age < 80)
```

## Re-sample according to weights, to account for biases within NHANES

```{r Re-sample for weights}
# makes the re-sample reproducible
set.seed(1)

copy <- sample(nrow(filtered_data), size = nrow(filtered_data), replace = TRUE, prob = filtered_data$WTMEC6YR)

# drop the weights now since we're already re-weighted
pop_like <- filtered_data[copy, ] |> select(-SDMVPSU, -SDMVSTRA, -WTMEC6YR, -Cycle)

cleaned_data <- na.omit(pop_like)
```

## Output cleaned data to CSV

```{r Output CSV}
write.csv(CDCdata, "data/cleaned_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Check Interaction Term

```{r}
male <- cleaned_data[cleaned_data$Sex == 'Male', ]
female <- cleaned_data[cleaned_data$Sex == 'Female', ]

plot(cleaned_data$BPSysAve ~ cleaned_data$Age, xlab="Age (Yr)", ylab="Systolic Blood Pressure Average (mmHg)", type="n")
points(male$BPSysAve ~ male$Age, col=adjustcolor("blue", alpha.f = 0.01), pch = 19)
points(female$BPSysAve ~ female$Age, col=adjustcolor("pink", alpha.f = 0.05), pch = 19)
lines(lowess(male$BPSysAve ~ male$Age), col="blue")
lines(lowess(female$BPSysAve ~ female$Age), col="red")

legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Male", "Female"), 
       col = c(adjustcolor("blue", alpha.f = 0.5), adjustcolor("red", alpha.f = 0.5)), 
       pch = 19, 
       bty = "n")
```

## Linear Model

```{r}
model <- lm(BPSysAve ~ Age + Sex + Race3 + BMI + PhysActive + AlcoholYear + SmokeNow + SleepHrsNight + CompletedCollege + Age:Sex, data=cleaned_data)

summary(model)
```

## Assumption Checkin

```{r}
# Residual Vs Fitted
plot(fitted(model), resid(model), main="Residual vs Fitted")

# use this command to plot these in a single grid
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
# Residual vs each quantitative predictor
y_value = resid(model)
plot(x = cleaned_data$Age, y = y_value, main="Residual vs Age",
xlab="Age", ylab="Residual")
plot(x = cleaned_data$BMI, y = y_value, main="Residual vs BMI",
xlab="BMI", ylab="Residual")
plot(x = cleaned_data$AlcoholYear, y = y_value, main="Residual vs No. Alcohol bottle per year",
xlab="Alcohol", ylab="Residual")
plot(x = cleaned_data$SleepHrsNight, y = y_value, main="Residual vs Hours Slept",
xlab="Hours Slept", ylab="Residual")

# make another grid
par(mfrow=c(2,3))
# Residual vs each categorical predictor boxplots
boxplot(y_value ~ cleaned_data$Sex , main="Residual vs Gender",
xlab="Gender", ylab="Residuals")
boxplot(y_value ~ cleaned_data$Race3 , main="Residual vs Race",
xlab="Race", ylab="Residuals")
boxplot(y_value ~ cleaned_data$PhysActive , main="Residuals vs Fitness",
xlab="Exercise?", ylab="Residuals")
boxplot(y_value ~ cleaned_data$SmokeNow , main="Residuals vs Smoke",
xlab="Smoking Now?", ylab="Residuals")
boxplot(y_value ~ cleaned_data$CompletedCollege , main="Residuals vs College Completion",
xlab="College Grad?", ylab="Residuals")

# QQplot
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model))
```

```{r}
plot(fitted(model), cleaned_data$BPSysAve, xlab = 'Estimated Diastolic BP Values', ylab = 'Observed Diastolic BP Values', 
     main = "Actual vs. Estimated Diastolic Blood Pressure Values", pch = 16, col='blue')
abline(a=0, b=1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

## Table

```{r}
# Numerical variables summary
num_vars <- cleaned_data[, c("BPSysAve", "Age", "BMI", "AlcoholYear", "SleepHrsNight")]
summary(num_vars)
sapply(num_vars, function(x) c(SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), IQR = IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
# Count of missing (NA) values for each numerical variable
colSums(is.na(num_vars))

# Quick fixing
fix <- cleaned_data[, c("PhysActive", "SmokeNow", "CompletedCollege")]
fix$PhysActive2 <- factor(fix$PhysActive, 
                                       levels = c(0, 1), 
                                       labels = c("Fat", "Fit"))
fix$SmokeNow2 <- factor(fix$SmokeNow, 
                                       levels = c(0, 1), 
                                       labels = c("Non-smoking", "Smoking"))
fix$CompletedCollege2 <- factor(fix$CompletedCollege, 
                                       levels = c(0, 1), 
                                       labels = c("Failed", "Finished"))

# Categorical variables summary
table(cleaned_data$Sex, useNA = "always")
prop.table(table(cleaned_data$Sex)) * 100

table(cleaned_data$Race3, useNA = "always")
prop.table(table(cleaned_data$Race3)) * 100

table(fix$PhysActive2, useNA = "always")
prop.table(table(fix$PhysActive2)) * 100

table(fix$SmokeNow2, useNA = "always")
prop.table(table(fix$SmokeNow2)) * 100

table(fix$CompletedCollege2, useNA = "always")
prop.table(table(fix$CompletedCollege2)) * 100
```
